reason: The calendar has room: if everything works first time, a score is possible about 26 Sep 21:00 UTC, with ~2 days of slack. What fails is the probability of reaching a scored probe at all. It is about 0.10 on the friend A path as written and about 0.20 on a Kaggle-only path, well below 0.70. (1) The idea's own offline gate is a hard stop ('Pass -> retrain ... then build the kernel'), and the idea puts P(gate) at about 0.35. That caps P(scored) at 0.35 before any logistics. (2) Friend A: the idea assumes he holds data_external/dorado/tracks.npz and kaggle44b6_in_dorado.json. Those files came from the L3 line in Vitalii's session (tools/register_44b6_dorado.py reads the train GT and data_external/dorado; CONTEXT l.1281-1290), and nothing shows friend A has them. He has made no commits since 24 Sep 04:12 MSK. If #34 = 0.953, his 5070 Ti is already booked for the x138 lab cache (PROMPT_FRIEND_A.md top block; CONTEXT l.1543-1545). That same cache is the optional gate (d) this idea wants, so the two jobs compete for one GPU on 26 Sep. P(friend A runs this on 26 Sep) is about 0.4-0.5 (guess). (3) It cannot be implemented as described with the existing tools. (a) The 6bba positive-unlabelled masking has no hook: compute_detection_loss (tools/repo/scripts/train_unet_transformer.py l.535-593) gets `mask` = padding of the node list, not a voxel ignore mask, so a new loss patch in experiments/_lib/train_patches.py is needed. (b) Training on dense geffs was built into friend A's dense pipeline (tools/build_dense_gt.py), but that line was cancelled on 18 Sep and never ran end to end (CONTEXT l.1005; h_external-data-training.notes.md), so a Ultrack-source label builder is untested glue. (c) x138's pool holds one score array and one READMIT_MIN_SCORE (exp56 cell 5 load_low_detections / readmit_discarded_detections). The 'separate readmit threshold 0.9 for copy peaks' needs a source-tag array in the npz plus cell-5 changes. The copy also needs loading inside the two GPU-shard predict subprocesses (cell 4). tools/build_probe_kernel.py --base x138 accepts only divinsert|leafprune today (CONTEXT l.1509). This is 4-6 h of agent work plus tests, not a switch. (4) Runtime: x138 turns off relink, readmit and gapfill for the remaining movies after REPAIR_DEADLINE_S = 27,000 s (exp56 cell 0 l.73). Our observed scoring latency is about 7.5 h (h_ensembles-and-private.notes.md l.4), while the hidden-test runtime is not in the repo. A third detector pass per frame (+1 forward on top of 16 TTA forwards, plus peak finding; guess +3-8 % of total runtime) could push the last movies past the guard. That would switch off exactly the readmit/gapfill stages the copy feeds, and hurt the base as well. (5) The base itself is pending: the idea lives only in x138's low-detection pool, so if #34 < 0.953 (P about 0.15, guess) x138 is not our base and there is no host. (6) Even when scored, the expected effect (+0.001 central, idea's own) is a third of the 0.003 LB noise, so the probe cannot confirm or refute itself. Numbers checked and mostly correct: exp03B took 27 min on 2xT4 (experiments/RESULTS.md l.14); 1,337 readmitted nodes on the 4 dummy clips (CONTEXT l.1515); the z offset of about 0.43 um (wf_ideas_v2/r2_research_dorado-oos-lab.notes.md l.10); 63 placed clips (CONTEXT l.1283); readmit at 4 um/0.965 and gapfill at 0.5/3.5 um/3 % (DIFF.md sec.2). Also noted: the default det-neg-weight is 1e-2, normalised by the negative-voxel count (train_unet_transformer.py l.588, l.1227), so the 'unannotated neighbours taught as background' pressure is weaker than the mechanism implies. That is a value-lens point.

realistic_public_gain: 0..+0.002, central about +0.0005 (guess). That is the idea's +0.001 central, discounted for the lab caveat (x138's readmit gate trusts detector scores) and a possible runtime-guard loss. It is not measurable against 0.003 LB noise.
realistic_private_gain: 0..+0.002 (guess). It might be larger on dense private embryos, but a copy trained on one recording (44b6 = dorado) can be over-confident on 44b6-like tissue. Untested.
